This stable release rolls up dev pre-releases v2.77-dev … v2.80-dev, all of
which make the **Offerings** navigation and index follow the company you are
working in.

## Updated

- **The sidebar's Offerings list now follows the company selector.** Previously
  every offering you had access to was listed in the left navigation at once, no
  matter which company was chosen in the header switcher — with several companies
  configured that turned into a long, mixed list. The submenu now shows only the
  offerings belonging to the selected company, and swaps over as soon as you
  change the selection (no page reload needed).
- Under **All companies**, every offering you can see is still listed, but each
  entry is labelled with its company in brackets — `Offering 1 (Company A)` — so
  two companies that each have an offering with the same name are no longer
  indistinguishable in the nav.
- **The Offerings page now uses the same cards as Admin > Offerings.** The
  offering list was a row of thin single-line boxes that showed either the
  description or the specialisation count, but never both. Each offering is now
  a card of the same size and shape as the admin one, showing the description
  and a `N specialisations · M requirements` line together — and, under
  **All companies**, a badge naming the company it belongs to.

## Fixed

- **The sidebar now updates as soon as you import offerings.** Importing (or
  creating, renaming or deleting) an offering left the left-hand navigation
  showing the old list until you changed company in the header switcher or
  reloaded the page. The nav list now refreshes straight after the change.
- **Importing for a different company now takes you to that company.** If you
  were viewing Company A and imported offerings for Company B, the page came
  back still showing Company A — so it looked as though nothing had been
  imported. The header company switcher now moves to the company you imported
  for, and the offerings list and navigation update with it. The same applies to
  creating a new offering for another company. Under **All companies** nothing
  changes, since the new data is already in view.
- The current offering is now highlighted in the sidebar while you are viewing
  it. The highlight never appeared before, because the comparison included the
  `?companyId=` part of the link.
